title: China's Li warns against unilateralism in talks with Asean leaders

blocks.text: Chinese Premier Li Qiang on Monday appeared to take a swipe at the United States during a summit with leaders of the 11-member Association of Southeast Asian Nations in Manila, saying the world has witnessed “a growing trend of unilateralism and protectionism.” In remarks at the China-Asean summit, Li called on the two sides to strengthen relations by “jointly opposing external interference and safeguarding regional peace and stability.” Despite global turbulence, cooperation between China and Asean has advanced, with cooperative mechanisms further strengthened and connectivity steadily improved, Li added.
